jobs.title: Data Engineer | Talent Community
jobs.description: Job Description Data Engineer | Talent Community We Are Lennar Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders and a Fortune 500® company with a growing technology organization focused on innovation, data, digital experiences, and technology that helps shape the future of homebuilding. Data is at the center of that transformation. We're investing in modern data platforms and engineering capabilities that enable better decisions, smarter products, greater operational efficiency, and new ways of using data across the organization. Build Your Future in Data Engineering at Lennar We're always looking to connect with talented Data Engineers who are excited about building the platforms and products that turn data into something our teams can use to make better decisions. This is a proactive talent community opportunity for Data Engineers interested in exploring future opportunities with Lennar. While we may not have an immediate opening that matches your background, we'd like to get to know you and stay connected as our Enterprise Data & Analytics organization continues to grow. Whether your expertise is in data platforms, data pipelines, cloud data engineering, data architecture, data integration, streaming, analytics engineering, or another area of data engineering , we welcome the opportunity to learn more about your experience and career interests. What You Could Work On Depending on your background and future opportunities within the team, you may contribute to: Design, build, and operationalize scalable data engineering solutions for Lennar's data platforms and products. Build and optimize ETL and ELT pipelines that bring together data from diverse sources. Develop data ingestion and integration solutions using batch, incremental, change data capture (CDC), streaming, and API-based approaches. Design and implement data models, data warehouses, data lakes, and modern cloud data platforms. Build reliable, reusable, and maintainable data transformation processes that enable analysts, data scientists, and business teams to work with trusted data. Improve data quality, reliability, observability, monitoring, and error handling across data pipelines and platforms. Develop automated testing, CI/CD workflows, version control practices, and other engineering standards that improve the quality and speed of delivery. Partner with data analysts, data scientists, product teams, software engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data solutions that support real business outcomes. Help create self-service data capabilities that make it easier for teams across Lennar to access and use data. Contribute to data governance, security, compliance, and access-control practices. Troubleshoot complex data and platform issues and identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability. Stay current with emerging data technologies and engineering practices and help identify opportunities to apply them at Lennar. The Technologies You Could Work With Our data environment continues to evolve, and future opportunities may span a variety of technologies, platforms, and architectural approaches. Depending on the role and team, experience with technologies such as the following may be relevant: AWS, including services such as S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, EKS, EC2, and CloudWatch Snowflake and modern cloud data warehouse technologies dbt and modern analytics engineering practices SQL and Python ETL/ELT, data ingestion, CDC, REST APIs, and streaming Airflow, Prefect, or other orchestration and scheduling technologies GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software development practices Data modeling, data warehousing, data lakes, and data architecture Data governance, security, access controls, and data quality Data replication and integration technologies such as Qlik Replicate You don't need experience with every technology listed. We're interested in understanding the data challenges you've solved, the platforms you've built, and the technologies you're excited to work with next. What We're Looking For We're interested in connecting with Data Engineers across a range of experience levels and specialties who bring: Professional experience designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, platforms, products, or related engineering solutions. Strong understanding of data engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, transformation, ingestion, testing, monitoring, and data quality. Strong SQL skills and experience with one or more programming languages, such as Python. Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering technologies. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex technical challenges. The ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and data consumers. A growth mindset and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and approaches. An interest in understanding the business context behind the data and building solutions that create meaningful business value. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent professional experience. For more senior opportunities, experience with data architecture, technical leadership, mentoring, platform strategy, and designing highly scalable data solutions may also be relevant. Why Join Lennar? At Lennar, you'll have the opportunity to work on data challenges within a large, complex organization while helping build the capabilities that support our evolution into a more data and insights-driven company. You'll collaborate with professionals across data, analytics, software engineering, product, cybersecurity, and business functions , giving you the opportunity to work across a broad technology ecosystem and see how the solutions you build translate into real business impact. We're building a data organization that values technical excellence, problem solving, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning . As our data capabilities evolve, so do the opportunities for engineers to expand their expertise, take on meaningful challenges, and build a career with impact. Interested in What's Next? This is a proactive posting for our Data Engineering talent community and is not tied to a specific current opening. By expressing your interest, you'll have an opportunity to introduce yourself to our team and be considered for future Data Engineering opportunities that align with your experience, technical interests, and career goals. We'd love to learn more about you and stay connected as our Enterprise Data & Analytics organization grows. Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. Travel may be required, up to 10% of the time, to locations within the Lennar family of companies. This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. #IND-TECH Life at Lennar At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits. Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/> for the latest job opportunities. Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Apply

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry. Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together. What We’ll Need Wingstop is seeking a Data Engineer to build and maintain the pipelines that feed enterprise analytics and AI. You will develop ingestion and transformation workflows, model data for analytical use, and keep production pipelines reliable. This is a hands-on build role with room to grow — you will work alongside senior engineers, BI developers, and data scientists across a broad set of source systems and use cases. This role is based at the Global Support Center in Dallas, TX. Role Responsibilities Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines from source systems into the analytics platform Develop transformation logic and analytical data models for BI and data science consumption Monitor pipeline health; troubleshoot and resolve data issues and job failures Implement data quality checks and validation across critical datasets Write clean, tested, documented code and participate in code review Support onboarding of new data sources and third-party integrations Partner with BI developers and analysts to understand and meet data requirements Contribute to platform performance and cost optimization Follow established data governance, security, and access standards What You’ll Need Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) Certifications AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks certifications are a plus Tools & Technical Experience 1+ years of data engineering experience building and supporting production pipelines Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python Experience with a cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, Databricks, or Redshift Experience with dbt or comparable transformation tooling Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow Familiarity with AWS services (S3, Glue, Lambda) or a comparable cloud Understanding of data modeling fundamentals and dimensional design Git-based workflows and exposure to CI/CD API and file-based integration experience Exposure to streaming technologies is a plus People Skills Asks questions early and communicates blockers clearly Detail-oriented with a strong sense of data accuracy Collaborative and eager to learn from senior engineers Takes ownership of what they build Comfortable working in an Agile team Who You Are No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can. You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward. You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward. You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down. You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement. Benefits FLAVOR PERKS: Unlimited paid time off for exempt employees One paid volunteer day of your choice Competitive bonus structure for eligible roles Team member stock purchase plan Health savings or flexible spending account options 401k – (dollar for dollar on the first 3% and then 50 cents on the dollar for the next 2% for team member contributions up to 5% of eligible compensation) Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits Basic life and AD&D insurance provided Pet insurance Education Assistance Wellness reimbursement program Paid maternity and paternity leave Fun Is The Best Flavor Lunch provided every Tuesday and Thursday in office Discount on Wingstop gift cards Onsite game room Wingstop provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Talent Acquisition Operations
jobs.description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role As a Data Engineer, you will help to build and maintain the data foundations, reporting workflows, and automations that support Recruiting and Hiring Operations. This role will work cross-functionally with Hiring Operations, Recruiters, Data, Security, Privacy, and other technical and non technical partners to turn complex recruiting processes into reliable datasets, dashboards, and operational tools. The ideal candidate enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering and business operations. You will be expected to understand how recruiting workflows generate data and build practical solutions that improve day to day operations. This role is well suited for someone who can move fluidly between building a pipeline, debugging an integration, creating a dashboard, documenting an operating procedure, and helping stakeholders understand how to use the resulting tool.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Radar
jobs.description: <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Who we are</span></h2> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">About Stripe</span></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">About the team</span></h3> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Radar ML team builds the fraud detection models that protect Stripe's $1.9 trillion payment network from fraud. The team owns 10 real-time deep learning models that must constantly evolve to stay ahead of fraudsters. Each ML improvement translates directly into dollar impact for Stripe and its users. </span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The team's models also power the Radar product suite that tens of thousands of businesses use to screen payments and manage fraud. Radar is growing fast, and the team is actively building new products to protect against AI token theft, free trial abuse, and scripted attacks.</span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">What you’ll do</span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">In this role, you will own ML work across the full lifecycle: researching new fraud patterns, building and deploying models, and sharing results directly with top Stripe customers. You will have opportunities to optimize Stripe’s most intensive ML models, and opportunities to ship 0-to-1 products from scratch.&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Responsibilities</span></h3> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Build, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models that detect fraud across Stripe’s global payments network</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Research emerging fraud patterns like token theft and develop ML solutions to address them</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Apply advances in deep learning to improve model quality and detection rates at scale</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Co-build new fraud and abuse products directly with top users</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Who you are</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Minimum requirements</span></h3> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">2+ years of experience training, evaluating, and deploying ML models in a production environment</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Proficiency in Python and common data and ML frameworks like SQL, Spark, and PyTorch</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Strong knowledge of production ML systems; and data analysis, statistics, and experiment design fundamentals</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Active interest in the latest ML developments, and how they can be leveraged to solve business problems</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Strong software engineering skills and ability to design ML solutions through entire product stack</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Experience building and optimizing real-time, low-latency ML infrastructure at scale</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Experience applying ML to fraud detection, integrity, trust and safety, or a closely related domain</span></li> </ul>

jobs.title: Data Engineer

This role focuses on enabling efficient data processing, analytics, and decision-making by delivering reliable, high-quality data solutions in cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with AWS cloud services, data engineering best practices, and big data technologies , with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment supporting complex mission systems. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience) Demonstrated experience in data engineering and pipeline development Strong experience with AWS data services (e.g., S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, EMR) Proficiency in SQL and Python for data processing and transformation Experience working with large-scale data sets and big data technologies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
